name: Social Democrat
description: You believe in strong public programs, fair redistribution, and balancing freedom with social responsibility.

name: Progressive
description: You want bold reforms to tackle inequality and injustice. You value inclusivity and diversity.

name: Democratic Socialist
description: You believe in democratically implementing socialist policies while maintaining civil liberties and political freedoms.

name: Centrist
description: You believe in balance and compromise. You value both markets and government action.

name: Neoliberal
description: You trust markets, globalization, and institutional reform. You favor liberalized trade, market-friendly policy and international cooperation.

name: Classical Liberal
description: You emphasize individual liberty, rule of law, limited government, and free markets — a historic liberal tradition that is economically pro-market but socially/libertarian on civil freedoms.

name: Libertarian
description: You value personal freedom above all. You want minimal state role in the economy and private lives, and favor non-interventionist foreign policy.

name: Objectivist
description: Philosophically-driven pro-capitalist position (Ayn Rand / Objectivism): radical individualism, moral defense of laissez-faire capitalism, and strong commitment to individual rights.

name: Paleoconservative
description: You emphasize traditional values, national sovereignty, and non-interventionist foreign policy. You are skeptical of both big government and globalization.

name: Neoconservative
description: You favor free markets, traditional values, and an assertive foreign policy to promote democracy and national interests abroad.

name: Authoritarian Conservative
description: You emphasize law, order, and tradition. You support strong leadership and a firm stance abroad.

name: Nationalist Populist
description: You prioritize national sovereignty and culture, and favor protecting ordinary citizens from elite interests.

name: Authoritarian Civic Nationalist
description: You believe in a strong and unified nation guided by firm leadership. While you accept limited economic freedom, you emphasize order, stability, and assertive foreign engagement to protect national interests.

name: Anarchist
description: You reject centralized authority and prefer voluntary cooperation over state power.
